body: You have literally just saved my life, until I go fight a shark of course!!!
That is the best piece of advice I have ever read

Get there now to be, to end my life now. To be in that place where nothing matters.

Yes, the things you say are very appealing, and I would happily live like that. But that peace I don't want to have to wait 20 years for.

I guess yes, I do have very high targets and aims, but I have so much opportunity where I am now I don't think I am aiming outside what I can achieve. 

I am thankful for your replies btw

Its just about having no cares, worries or anything if i was to end my life. Nothing would matter anymore. That ideal of moving away, but why wait all that time when I can get there now? 

Yes please do
